- Keystore export is now explicitly described as MetaMask-compatible, clarifying wallet interoperability.
- Documentation updated for accuracy on keystore export and compatibility details.
- No major changes to scripts or core functionality in this version.

atxswap v0.0.8

- Clarified and strengthened wallet password recovery and keystore export safety rules.
- Added guidance on explaining encrypted password storage and refusal to reveal passwords or private keys in chat, even with user confirmation.
- Now requires explicit reminder and backup/export confirmation before wallet deletion or removal of key material.
- Documentation updated to reflect additional user protections and stricter safety flows.

atxswap v0.0.7

- Updated version to 0.0.7 in SKILL.md and package files.
- No functional commands or usage changes in scripts or documentation.
- Maintenance update; mainly version bump for dependency or packaging alignment.

atxswap 0.0.6

- Bumped package version to 0.0.6.
- Updated SKILL.md metadata to match the new version.
- No functional code changes; documentation and meta updates only.

0.0.4: removed wallet.js import (and the SDK importPrivateKey API). wallet.js export now emits the encrypted Keystore V3 JSON instead of the raw private key, and supports --out <file>. Bumped atxswap-sdk dependency to ^0.0.3.
Use atxswap-sdk@^0.0.2: built-in 8-endpoint BSC RPC fallback (replaced bare infura URL with bsc-rpc.publicnode.com), and BSC_RPC_URL now accepts a comma-separated list parsed as rpcUrls.
Switch SDK dependency from github:agentswapx/atxswap-sdk to atxswap-sdk@^0.0.1 on npm. Cuts first-time install from ~1 min to ~16s.

Initial release of atxswap skill for managing ATX on BSC:

- Provides wallet creation/import, password storage, and keystore management.
- Supports querying ATX/USDT price, balances, LP positions, and token info.
- Enables ATX buy/sell swaps, PancakeSwap V3 liquidity management, and BNB/ERC20 transfers.
- Enforces strong password and safety rules: previews, confirmations, and privacy protection.
- Requires Node.js 18+, npm, and BSC RPC access.
